scope: code-owned runtime observability and product analytics telemetry hardening

controls.name: Runtime crash telemetry remains available before sign-in
controls.proof: log_app_runtime_errors_batch remains executable by anon and authenticated roles so pre-login Flutter errors can be captured without exposing direct table writes.

controls.name: Product analytics is authenticated-only
controls.proof: Anonymous execute is revoked from log_product_event and log_product_events_batch; authenticated execute remains granted.

controls.name: Client roles cannot write observability tables directly
controls.proof: Direct table grants on app_runtime_errors and product_events are revoked from anon and authenticated roles, forcing writes through bounded RPCs.

controls.name: Telemetry payloads are bounded and redacted
controls.proof: Runtime telemetry batches are capped at 20, product analytics batches are capped at 50, timestamps are parsed safely, and token-like values are redacted before storage.

controls.name: Telemetry metadata and analytics properties are redacted
controls.proof: Nested telemetry metadata and product analytics properties are redacted through observability_redact_jsonb before storage, including token-like keys, bearer values, Supabase token-like values, API keys, and connection-string-like values.

controls.name: Runtime telemetry stores event type and metadata
controls.proof: app_runtime_errors now has event_type and metadata columns, allowing errors and runtime events to be distinguished in operations dashboards.

commands.proof: Validator checks this evidence, migration, SQL readiness test, runner, and Flutter telemetry wiring.
